title: F4 proponent: Beaufort + KRYPTOS substitution context (BCL enrichment family)
hypothesis_summary: The BCL (BERLIN-CLOCK Letter) Beaufort enrichment was based on an A=0 Beaufort-keystream observation at the BERLINCLOCK crib region. The underlying palette construct {B,G,I,K,O,W,Z} was RETIRED 2026-04-01 as a post-hoc selection artifact (memory/retired/bcl_palette_keystream.md). The proponent reading retains the structural intuition — Beaufort substitution remains the natural arithmetic for the disclosed crib region — but uses the public KRYPTOS keyword from the construction record as the substitution key and explicitly disclaims the retired palette construct. This is the project-policy-clean version of the BCL family.

provenance_items.quote_or_summary: Anomaly E0b (Materna 2020 / Bean 2021 §2.4): for the 10 of 24 known PT positions where PT in {K,R,Y,P,T,O,S}, CT letters cluster very near in standard alphabet (mean delta 2.1, p ~ 1/5520). Strong evidence the cipher alphabet is keyword-mixed near KRYPTOS.
KRYPTOS is the K1/K2/K3 alphabet keyword.

composition_templates.rationale: Beaufort substitution + keyed columnar with KRYPTOS / BERLIN keyword pair. The Beaufort arithmetic is the ONE structural commitment carried over from the BCL family.

constraints: Beaufort required. Keyword pool restricted to KRYPTOS and BERLIN. NO retired palette construct ({B,G,I,K,O,W,Z}) is referenced.
caveats: PROPONENT framing built around the SURVIVING evidence (anomaly E0b), NOT the retired palette construct.

The original BCL palette {B,G,I,K,O,W,Z} was retired as post-hoc selection artifact — see memory/retired/bcl_palette_keystream.md and docs/a1_score_conditioned_null_report.md. This pack does NOT cite that palette.
